caseName: Southern Railway Co. v. North Carolina
caseNameFull: Southern Railway Co. v. North Carolina and United States v. North Carolina
attorneys: Edward J. Hickey, Jr. and James L. Highsaw, Jr. on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeals from the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 373 U. S. 907.) The motion of the Railway Labor Executives’ Association for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.
